evidence.title: DeMixPert: Decomposed Response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for OOD Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction

summary: The new DeMixPert framework decomposes cellular response modeling using Gaussian mixtures, enabling more accurate prediction of how cells react to unseen genetic or chemical perturbations. This advancement improves the reliability of single‑cell analyses in drug discovery and functional genomics.
title: Researchers unveil DeMixPert, a Gaussian‑mixture model for out‑of‑distribution single‑cell perturbation prediction
